init.title: Advanced capability codes
init.description: Each feature below is disabled by default (0) because capability codes vary by hood model. Enter the code discovered on your hood (see DISCOVERY.md) to enable a feature; set it back to 0 to remove it.

data_description.cap_air_quality: 0 = no air quality sensor. Code 112 on Elica Illusion (dataModelIdx 8).
data_description.fan_auto_value: 0 = no Auto preset. Value 16 on Elica Illusion (dataModelIdx 8).
data_description.cap_light_color: 0 = main light without color control. Code 97 on Elica Illusion (dataModelIdx 8).
data_description.cap_ambient_brightness: 0 = your hood has no ambient light, the entity is not created. Code 100 on Elica Illusion (dataModelIdx 8).
data_description.cap_ambient_color: 0 = ambient light dimmer-only (e.g. Elica Illusion). Set only if your ambient light has a warm/cold slider in the app.
data_description.keepalive_minutes: How often to poll the Elica cloud while MQTT push is active. Default 5. Lower it (1-2) if your hood drops off Wi-Fi due to power management; raise it to reduce cloud traffic.
data_description.aggressive_keepalive: On every keep-alive cycle, also send a harmless command (echo of the current light brightness) that forces the hood itself to wake up and acknowledge over MQTT. Enable only if the hood still drops off Wi-Fi with a short poll interval.
data_description.cap_timer: 0 = no timer. Code 432 on Elica Illusion (dataModelIdx 8).
data_description.mqtt_host: Elica cloud MQTT broker. Change only if Elica moves it; default cloudprodmqtt.elica.com.
